title: Untitled (Page on Bands)
description: Mixed-media collage centered on a white rectangular panel bearing scattered paint marks and handwritten text, overlaid on vertical yellow bands; surrounding field incorporates concentric target motifs, compact discs, printed ephemera, black brushwork, and fragments of photographic and grid-patterned materials in red, blue, gold, and black.
composition: central blank panel on roundel field, disc base
dimensions_source: CD reference: 2 discs, radii 170.8px and 156.8px native, 8.9% spread (real measurement variance, not a data error). Visually confirmed real, gold, unobscured discs. Estimated 2026-08-03.
